    public static void main(String[] args) {

        System.out.println(ok(w, m) ? "YES" : "NO");

        if (m <= 0) return true;
        int d = m % w;
        int next = m / w;
        if (d > w / 2) {
            d = w - d;
            next++;
        }
        if (d > 1) return false;
        return ok(w, next);
    }
}

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class BasicJava {
    static class FastScanner {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        String next() {
            try {
                while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
                    String line = br.readLine();
                    if (line == null) return null;
                    st = new StringTokenizer(line);
                }
                return st.nextToken();
            } catch (IOException e) {
                throw new RuntimeException(e);
            }
        }

        int nextInt() {
            String s = next();
            if (s == null) throw new RuntimeException("EOF");
            return Integer.parseInt(s);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        FastScanner fs = new FastScanner();
        int w = fs.nextInt();
        int m = fs.nextInt();

        List<Integer> digits = new ArrayList<>();
        while (m > 0) {
            digits.add(m % w);
            m /= w;
        }

        if (digits.isEmpty()) {
            System.out.println("YES");
            return;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < digits.size(); i++) {
            int d = digits.get(i);
            if (d > w / 2) {
                digits.set(i, w - d);
                if (i + 1 == digits.size()) {
                    digits.add(0);
                }
                digits.set(i + 1, digits.get(i + 1) + 1);
            }
        }

        if (digits.get(digits.size() - 1) == 1) {
            digits.add(0);
        }

        for (int d : digits) {
            if (d > 1) {
                System.out.println("NO");
                return;
            }
        }
        System.out.println("YES");
    }
}

                m = (m - 1) / w;

                m = (m + 1) / w;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;

public class BasicJava {
    private static int readInt() throws IOException {
        InputStream in = System.in;
        int c = in.read();
        while (c <= ' ') {
            c = in.read();
        }
        int sign = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sign = -1;
            c = in.read();
        }
        int n = 0;
        while (c > ' ') {
            n = n * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = in.read();
        }
        return n * sign;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        int w = readInt();
        int m = readInt();
        System.out.println(ok(w, m) ? "YES" : "NO");
    }

    private static boolean ok(int w, int m) {
        if (m <= 0) return true;
        int r = m % w;
        if (r == 0) return ok(w, m / w);
        if (r == 1) return ok(w, (m - 1) / w);
        if (r == w - 1) return ok(w, (m + 1) / w);
        return false;
    }
}
